support-alice: FYI - Customer Acme reported a sharp spike at ~09:12 UTC that produced a flood of 5xxs and gateway timeouts for hosted inference. They hit timeouts for ~30s, lots of gateway 504s. Repro steps and logs below.

support-alice: sample gateway log:```[2026-03-16T09:12:14Z] gateway INFO request_id=rid-72a path=/v1/generate tenant=acme status=504 reason=upstream_request_timeout upstream=upstream-infer-23 latency_ms=30010```

support-alice: Repro (quick):
1) run: `wrk -t2 -c100 -d30s http://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <acct-token>" -H "X-Tenant: acme"`
2) observe 504s after ~8s of sustained QPS.

sre-ben: Thanks Alice. Can you paste a few correlation IDs? Also did we see any KEDA/HPA scale events? Run `kubectl get hpa,scaledobject -n inference -o wide` and `kubectl logs -n inference controller-keda --since=20m | grep acme`

support-alice: correlation ids: rid-72a, rid-72b, rid-730. I attached the `kubectl get` output snippet:```NAME                                   READY   TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
scaledobject.acme-infer-scaledobj       0/1     30%       1         20        1          3h
hpa/acme-infer-hpa                      1/1     75%       1         10        1          3h```

infra-maya: Looking at infra metrics - we saw a spike in pending pod creation and a backlog on the node pool. KEDA emitted a scale event but pods stayed in ContainerCreating for long time. Readiness probes for the runtime are failing during model init:```liveness/readiness: exec probe failed: model-init timed out after 60s -> reason: model fetch + mmap slow```

infra-maya: There's also a recent change at 4109876000 from the scale-config patch that reduced `keda.cooldownSeconds` to 10s and lowered `initialReplicaCount` for this tenant class to 1. That can cause oscillation when bursts hit.deploy-bot: deploy 4109876000 scale-config patch applied by infra-maya -comment: lowered keda.cooldownSeconds to 10

runtime-lee: Two things to mitigate immediately: 1) enable prewarm replicas for heavy tenants: set `scaledobject.annotations["redwood.com/prewarm"]="true"` and bump `initialReplicaCount` to 3; 2) add a fallback model variant (smaller quantized) for warm boot to avoid long mmap. Example scaledobject fragment:```apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: acme-infer-scaledobj
  annotations:
    redwood.com/prewarm: "true"
spec:
  minReplicaCount: 3
  maxReplicaCount: 20
  cooldownPeriod: 60
```

runtime-lee: Also enable prefix/KV caching for session warmups so subsequent requests don't require full model init. We can push a temporary routing rule to send burst traffic to quantized-llama-small variant.

sre-ben: Agreed. Plan:
- infra-maya to roll back 4109876000 change or bump cooldown to 60s (stop thrash) (ETA 15m)
- infra to increase `initialReplicaCount` for tenant class to 3 (ETA 10m)
- runtime to enable prewarm & register fallback model (ETA 20m)
- support to ask customer to throttle to 50% for 30m while we stabilize (Alice)

support-alice: I'll ask Acme to apply a temporary client-side rate limit and gather more rid samples. Sending them a workaround doc and ETA. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

pm-jordan: Also propose offering Acme a short Dedicated capacity trial for predictable bursts while we harden autoscale behavior. I'll draft the outreach.

infra-maya: Rolling change now: bumping keda.cooldownSeconds -> 60 and setting initialReplicaCount=3 for acme class. Will monitor events.

deploy-bot: rollback/change 4109877001 applied by infra-maya - comment: bump cooldown + initial replicas for acme

sre-ben: After the change we should watch these metrics:
- HPA/SO replicas count
- pod startup times (`kubectl get pods -w`)
- gateway 5xx rate by tenant (from API gateway dashboards)

runtime-lee: If we still see long ContainerCreating due to model fetch, we can push a short-term OCI image with the model prepacked to nodes (preloaded artifacts) — will prepare steps.

support-alice: Customer confirmed temporary rate limit applied. Seeing 5xx drop to near zero after ~4m. Will keep collecting logs and follow-up. :white_check_mark:

sre-ben: Good. After stabilization we'll schedule a postmortem and update autoscale runbook with: prewarm annotation, cooldown defaults, initialReplicaCount by tenant class, and fallback model routing.

support-alice: I'll coordinate the postmortem notes once we confirm full recovery.

runtime-lee: ETA for fallback model route: 40m. Infra: please keep the increased initial replicas until then.

infra-maya: roger, keeping config for 2h and monitoring.

support-alice: closing for now but leaving thread open for logs. Thanks team.
